foundry_calls.text: Work? Maybe. Folk have been vanishing up by the old crypt — three this month. The watch won't go near the place. A sellsword with more steel than sense might find answers there.
foundry_calls.speaker: Borin

foundry_calls.text: He slides your ale across the bar. 'On the house — you earned it yesterday.'
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I ask Borin if there's any work for a sellsword.
